Name: Characters Hairstyles (Vanilla) (CP)
Author: UlyanaLeyana
Description:
If you like some of the NPC' hairstyles and was very sad that you can't have the same hairstyle, then no need to be sad anymore. Now you can choose any NPC' hairstyle you like and even recolor it! Some of them was slightly edited to match a farmer sprite.
[b][color=#cc0000]
[size=4]Install[/size][/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿  version 1.20.0 or higher.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI once to generate config.json
[*]Edit config.json to your liking.

[/list]
[b]Config options[/b]:
"Colored" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")
"Paintable" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")

Enjoy!
